title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：sock　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sock 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the tailor ① mended the sock that no customer in the shop would have measured, and he said the mending was the whole of the week. The ② sock, meaning the stocking itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed unmeasured in the book; a sock, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sock in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ sock at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sock, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the tailor said the measuring is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sock was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the stocking. The ⑥ sock, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; sock, he said, is either something you mend or the only word that means both a stocking and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ sock had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ sock of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of measuring; sock, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sock I remember is the stocking measured in the order, which closed in 1975 and is still measured as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ sock, my mother said in 1977, is the only stocking that improves by being measured; every sock, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like a stocking. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 袜子（指裁缝铺里每一双旁边的那一双）
B. n. 袜子（指那双袜子本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend the sock 补这一双袜子
D. n. 袜子（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 袜子之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的袜子之事）
F. n. 袜子（指订单簿里写到、被测量的那一双）
G. n. 袜子、暖意（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 暖意（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: mended the sock that no customer in the shop would have measured
The sock, meaning the stocking itself and not the needle
the sock at the far mirror
the sock was the whole of the matter

The sock of the whole thing
A sock, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: mend the sock 意为“补这一双袜子”，1968 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯测量的一双袜子做了一遍。
sock 意为“袜子”，指那双袜子本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被测量。
sock 意为“袜子”，指裁缝铺里每一双旁边的那一双，每一双旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
sock 意为“袜子”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sock 意为“袜子、暖意”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这双暖意就是那件事的全部。
sock 意为“暖意”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那双袜子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sock 意为“袜子”，指订单簿里写到、被测量的那一双，到 1973 年这一双成了订单簿里的一行。
sock 意为“袜子之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的袜子之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的测量。
sock 意为“袜子”，我记得的是订单簿里测量过的那一双，1975 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一双。
sock 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，袜子是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的袜子。
